groups.heading: Method
steps: Tip the flour onto a clean surface or into a processor or mixer and add the eggs (and yolks).
Bring together and knead to a smooth, silky, elastic dough. Add flour if sticky, a little egg if dry.
Wrap and rest about 30 minutes, then roll and cut as you like, dusting with semolina.

resolvedChecks.note: Only the first part of the method was photographed. Resting and rolling are the standard steps.
resolvedChecks.resolution: Standard resting and rolling steps kept.
